source.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary for Schools Trainer · Exam Practice
source.selection: B1+–B2 useful vocabulary appearing on original Exam Practice pages; examples and explanations created for learning.

words.definition: before a particular time or event
words.example: Please book your tickets in advance to avoid disappointment.
words.cloze: Please book your tickets ________ to avoid disappointment.

words.definition: to take something for a time and return it later
words.example: You can borrow a novel from the school library.
words.cloze: You can ________ a novel from the school library.

words.definition: to be owned by a particular person
words.example: Does this jacket belong to anyone in our class?
words.cloze: Does this jacket ________ anyone in our class?

words.definition: paintings, drawings or other artistic creations
words.example: She included her best artwork in her application.
words.cloze: She included her best ________ in her application.

words.definition: a formal request to join or enter something
words.definitionVi: đơn đăng ký; hồ sơ ứng tuyển
words.example: He completed his college application before Friday.
words.cloze: He completed his college ________ before Friday.

words.definition: to make a book or writing available to the public
words.example: She hopes to publish her illustrated stories next year.
words.cloze: She hopes to ________ her illustrated stories next year.

words.definition: a particular method of doing something
words.example: The art teacher showed us a new printing technique.
words.cloze: The art teacher showed us a new printing ________.

words.definition: a picture or photograph of a person
words.example: He painted a portrait of his grandfather.
words.cloze: He painted a ________ of his grandfather.

words.definition: involving one teacher and one learner
words.example: She prefers one-to-one lessons when learning to draw.
words.cloze: She prefers ________ lessons when learning to draw.

words.definition: appearing to be made by an expert
words.example: His professional-looking poster impressed the class.
words.cloze: His ________ poster impressed the class.

words.definition: programs used by computers
words.example: The designer uses special software to create posters.
words.cloze: The designer uses special ________ to create posters.

words.definition: a view of natural scenery or a picture of it
words.example: We painted a landscape with hills and rivers.
words.cloze: We painted a ________ with hills and rivers.

words.definition: to try different ideas or methods to see what works
words.example: Students can experiment with different painting styles.
words.cloze: Students can ________ different painting styles.

words.definition: to move something from one place or surface to another
words.example: You can transfer the design onto cotton fabric.
words.cloze: You can ________ the design onto cotton fabric.

words.definition: to share suggestions and opinions with others
words.example: The students meet online to exchange ideas about art.
words.cloze: The students meet online to ________ about art.

words.definition: visiting interesting places while travelling
words.example: We spent our first day sightseeing along the coast.
words.cloze: We spent our first day ________ along the coast.

words.definition: to plan or mean to do something
words.example: We intend to travel by bus instead of driving.
words.cloze: We ________ to travel by bus instead of driving.

words.definition: extremely tired
words.example: After the long walk, everyone felt exhausted.
words.cloze: After the long walk, everyone felt ________.

words.definition: a sudden curve in a road
words.example: Drivers must slow down before a sharp bend.
words.cloze: Drivers must slow down before a ________.

words.definition: to make someone agree to do something
words.example: They tried to persuade Dad to join the guided tour.
words.cloze: They tried to ________ Dad to join the guided tour.

words.definition: a reduction in the usual price
words.example: Students receive a discount on bus tickets.
words.cloze: Students receive a ________ on bus tickets.

words.definition: approximately; not exactly
words.example: The journey takes roughly two hours.
words.cloze: The journey takes ________ two hours.

words.definition: very comfortable and expensive
words.example: They stayed in a luxury tent near the beach.
words.cloze: They stayed in a ________ tent near the beach.

words.definition: feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something
words.example: I felt embarrassed when I realised my mistake.
words.cloze: I felt ________ when I realised my mistake.
